description.value:
Duration constant

Once per day, when an ally within 60 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may have them instead be reduced to 1 Hit Point. This doesn't require an action to use.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Once per day, an ally within 60 feet who'd be reduced to 0 HP is instead reduced to 1, no action required" is P-CROSS: an ongoing numeric/state intervention on a DIFFERENT creature's own HP total, sourced from the card holder's own passive. No selector for this exists anywhere in pf2e-source.
